name: RC-B10-0476/2026 – After § 4 – Am 1
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the escalation of Russian strikes in the EU, particularly on Black Sea shipping, threatening human life, regional stability and food security
part_text: 4a. Stresses the importance of and urgent need for a moratorium on strikes against merchant vessels and other civilian ships in the Black Sea; underlines that the Black Sea could serve as a theatre for the gradual de-escalation of the conflict;
